newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-GRADY OUT OF OPEN QUALIFYING.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-GRADY OUT OF OPEN QUALIFYING.

text.p: Wayne Grady of Australia, who lost in a three-man play-off for the British Open title at Royal Troon in 1989, will not be in the field when the event returns to the same course next week.
Grady was not among the exempted players for the Open and has decided not to take part in final qualifying on Sunday and Monday.
He and compatriot Greg Norman were beaten by Mark Calcavecchia in the four-hole play-off in 1989.
